subject.title: feat(anthropic): import Claude Desktop custom groups

question: Should OpenClaw support importing Claude Desktop’s undocumented account-local custom-group store as a bundled Anthropic catalog enhancement, accepting graceful loss of grouping when Desktop changes that storage format?
rationale: The code is extension-owned and bounded, but parsing a private external storage format is a product support commitment that automated review cannot make on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Accept bounded Desktop import
options.body: Keep the read-only, best-effort parser in the Anthropic extension and require redacted live proof plus protocol/native-client validation before merge.

options.title: Defer private-store support
options.body: Keep custom grouping out of the bundled catalog until Claude Desktop exposes a stable supported source or maintainers define a broader compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded Desktop import
recommendation.body: Keep the read-only, best-effort parser in the Anthropic extension and require redacted live proof plus protocol/native-client validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history supplied for this PR shows direct ownership of the implementation and its parser-correctness follow-up.
